subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw expose `captionedFinalText` as a public channel plugin capability and enable bundled voice-note captions by default for Telegram final-mode TTS?
rationale: The code defect is mechanically repairable, but the durable plugin API and existing-user presentation change require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bundled captions
options.body: Accept the capability and Telegram default after per-send recovery is fixed and current-head Telegram proof shows no duplication.

options.title: Add delivery choice first
options.body: Support both bundled and separate text-plus-voice presentation before changing Telegram’s existing default.

options.title: Keep the policy Telegram-private
options.body: Implement the fix through an owner-specific Telegram seam without exposing a new public plugin capability.

recommendation.title: Approve bundled captions
recommendation.body: Accept the capability and Telegram default after per-send recovery is fixed and current-head Telegram proof shows no duplication.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest available history signal on the shared dispatch boundary and no narrower CODEOWNER is declared.
